ravi_swe: quick note from today's onboarding run. sampleapp set prefetch=3 and we saw either a long hang or a short burst when STS rotated mid-scan.
zoe_doc: can you share a minimal repro? is this the auth-refresh+pager interaction we've seen elsewhere?
ravi_swe: yep. minimal flow: pager prefetch=3; Generate() triggers Token.refresh() synchronously in Go SDK. while refresh blocks, pager keeps filling queue; when refresh succeeds backlog fires -> transient 429s. sometimes threads block and onboarding stalls.
mike_go: pattern sounds like we need a tiny yield after refresh or an opt-in FetchBlocking. which do you prefer for short-term?
anya_py: py default is async refresh so it naturally yields; parity gap across SDKs. short-term: lower sampleapp default to prefetch=1. medium: add yield in Go SDK and opt-in pager.FetchBlocking for apps.
ravi_swe: I tried pager.FetchBlocking=true in sampleapp — burst disappears but tail latency worsens. tradeoff noted in README.
zoe_doc: let's update quickstart: change default prefetch=1 and add a troubleshooting blurb about auth-rotation causing backpressure. add a short log snippet showing "token refresh start/finish" and queue depth.
ci-bot: created DEVEX-1188 "sampleapp-prefetch-auth-yield-fix" and attached logs
mike_go: I'll open a small PR to add a goroutine hand-off after token refresh and a flag to opt-in until we ship parity. will add an integration test with flaky STS.
anya_py: i'll add a note for SDK parity checklist so we don't forget other runtimes.
ravi_swe: thanks all. i'll drop the sampleapp patch and the README change tonight. :thumbsup:
